# Crypto WebIDL component controls

Use exact Node26.13.0 with --expose-internals. Native is reference only; candidate
uses actual generated factories, full unchanged generic WebIDL source and native
key handles/Buffer/Values/type/digest owners as declared fixture dependencies.
Controls cover conversion/order/brand/backing and actual toCryptoKey invalid-input
admission; they do not implement a normalizer or import path. Frontier observations
are retained nonpasses, never counted as converter/public import compatibility.
